name: Deontologist
description: Rules are rules, even when breaking them would help
behavioral_signature: Follows moral duties regardless of consequences
under_stress: Clings harder to rules even as the world burns around them
at_rest: Lives by a clear, unshakeable code of conduct
will_always: follow the rule, not the result
will_never: justify wrong means with right ends
unless: the rule itself was built on a lie
